notes: All prices read 2026-10-14 from each provider's own pages or the data feeds those pages load; no aggregator was used. In quotes, ' | ' separates table cells as rendered and '->' joins a table header to its row. Most pages were rendered in headless Chromium (Playwright) because they load prices with JavaScript. AWS prices come from the price-list JSON that aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/ and aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/compute-pricing/ load (b0.p.awsstatic.com). Azure H100 prices come from the price feed that the Azure Linux VM pricing page loads (East US is the page's default region). The page itself shows monthly figures. Azure ND GB200 v6 is absent from that page, so its prices come from Microsoft's Retail Prices API (prices.azure.com). That API also lists a GB200 Spot SKU at the full $108.16, so no GB200 spot rate is recorded. Azure's 5-year reserved rate for ND96isr H100 v5 is $39.3279908676 per instance-hour ($4.9160 per GPU-hour). AWS's spot feed (website.spot.ec2.aws.a2z.com/spot.js) lists p5.48xlarge in us-east-1 at $57.7618 per hour, above the $55.04 on-demand rate, so it looks stale and is left out. AWS also lists p6-b300.48xlarge on-demand at $142.416 per instance-hour ($17.802 per GPU-hour) in us-east-1. Vultr's pricing page returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and to plain headless Chromium. It rendered after disabling the automation flag. Vultr's public plans API (api.vultr.com/v2/plans) is used only to cross-check. Several providers price per GPU-hour and do not say how many GPUs an instance holds. Those offers carry gpus_per_instance null. Single-GPU or PCIe-only offers: Runpod pods and Verda rows are priced per single GPU (multi-GPU pods and instances scale linearly). Hyperstack, Runpod and Azure NC H100 v5 also sell H100 PCIe or NVL. Lambda's 1-Click Cluster H100 rate ($5.54 to $6.16) sits above its own on-demand 8x instance rate ($3.99), as published. Nebius says commitments cut up to 35% off on-demand and gives no rate card for them. Verda reserved figures are derived from its published percentage discounts (1 month 2%, 3 months 3%, 6 months 4%, 1 year 8%, 2 years 25%). No provider page showed a live sold-out flag for H100. The only availability signals are GCP's N/A for A4 on-demand and Vultr's API listing no deployable locations.
